sources.name: CodeWhale configuration/doctor contract
facts: api_key.source and capability route fields are documented
auth status reports credential source without printing the key

sources.name: OpenCode CLI
facts: auth list lists stored authenticated providers
environment variables and project .env can also supply credentials

sources.name: Codex developer commands
facts: codex login status reports active authentication mode and exits 0 when logged in

sources.name: Claude Code setup
facts: claude doctor is a read-only installation/settings diagnostic

interpretation: Authentication probes are evidence for one layer only; they are warnings rather than launch blockers because custom providers, environment keys, project .env files and local/keyless routes may remain valid.
